text: Long catch up with Laura. Her mum's having a knee replacement on 14 November, first thing in the morning. Laura's taking the week off to stay with her. Remind me to text Laura that evening.
Coffee with Anil after the client call. His manager Sinead is leaving at Christmas and he's quietly hoping for her role. He's also training for a 10k in March.
Kai rang. Gallbladder op went fine on Tuesday, home since yesterday, still sore but cracking jokes. His partner Freya is doing all the lifting. I should drop round soup at the weekend.
Yetunde's dad is in St Thomas' after a fall. Scan on the 3rd of December at half 10. She sounded wrecked, hasn't slept properly in days. Don't forget to message her the day before the scan.

Lunch with Sadia and Sean. Sadia's been promoted to team lead, starts 1 Dec. Sean is off to Lisbon for a client pitch on 26/11 and is bricking it. Must text Sean good luck that morning. Sadia also said her husband Joseph is waiting on a date for his back surgery, probably January, and she's dreading juggling it with the new role.
Grace mentioned her cat Pickle needs a dental op next Thursday. She's more nervous about that than her own appraisal.
Joseph's retiring end of January after 31 years. Leaving do is Friday 30th at 6pm at the Crown. Need to sort a collection for him the week before.
Delroy - knee arthroscopy Monday 9am. Recovery 6 weeks min. Wife Bethany driving him in.

Call with Lwazi went long. His boss, Mrs Baker, finally signed off the reorg, so his team moves to the Leeds office in the new year. He's fine with it, Thandi less so. Big Manchester United fan, still sulking about Sunday.
Sinead's wedding is off. She and Callum split a couple of weeks ago, she's staying at her sister's for now. Remind me to check in on Sinead next week, gently.
Hiroshi Tanaka from the Osaka account visiting 18-20 November. Dinner booked Wednesday at 7. He's vegetarian and doesn't drink.
Mustafa had his hernia repair on the 2nd, back at work already which seems mad. His daughter starts nursery after half term. Ask him the week after how she's settling in.

Dawit said his brother Abdi is having a kidney transplant in the new year, Dawit's the donor. Pre-op assessment 12/12 at 2pm. He's calm about it but his mum is beside herself. I should call Dawit the evening after the assessment.
pick up prescription before 5, then dry cleaning
Zhang's PhD viva is 5 December at 10am. Her supervisor reckons it'll be fine but she's a mess about it. Text her good luck the night before!

Ran into Yasmin at the hospital car park. Her husband Tobi had a mild stroke two weeks ago, out of ICU now, speech coming back slowly. She's back at work part time to cover. Want to send a card to Tobi and maybe offer to do the school run on Thursdays.
Khadija - new job at Deloitte, starts 6 Jan. Leaving drinks 19 Dec, Friday at half 5. Get her something for the new desk, she's been hinting about a decent plant.
Kavya is having her wisdom teeth out tomorrow morning. Only liquids for a week, so the Thai on Saturday is cancelled. Remind me to message her tomorrow evening to see how it went.

Team meeting recap: Isaac's on paternity leave from the 20th, baby due 22nd of December. Camila covering his clients. Eamon still off sick with his back, no return date. Must sign Isaac's card before Friday. Also Camila mentioned the Suzuki renewal is due 30/11 and the client's new procurement lead is a nightmare, so expect a few late nights from her.
Magda's anniversary dinner with Oliver - 10 years on 8 Nov. She asked me to recommend somewhere. Oliver's dairy free.
Olga's had the all clear from the breast clinic! Results came back Monday. Had been dreading it for weeks. Need to send her flowers.
Sana told me her dog Biscuit went missing on Saturday, found him Sunday night two streets away. Also, she's moving to Bristol in February.
Quick one: Abdi's appendix out Friday night, emergency. Home Tuesday. Off work 3 weeks.
Bethany said Delroy's knee op went well and he's already bored stupid. She's doing all the driving until 6 Dec. Pop round with the box set next weekend.

Chatted to Laura again after book club. Her mum's recovery is slow, physio twice a week. Laura's thinking of going part time to help out. Her son Kai Murphy (not my Kai!) is sitting his driving test 21/11 and is a nervous wreck. Remind me to send him a good luck text the day before.
Note for me: dentist 14 Nov 8.40am, then working from home.
Anil's mum passed away on Saturday. Funeral is the 4th of November at 11 in Leicester. I'm driving up with Sean. Should send Anil a message tonight, nothing long.
Grace's appraisal with her new manager is on Thursday at 3pm. She's worried because her numbers dipped while she was caring for her dad. Remind me to message her after, that evening.
Freya's off to Japan for three weeks on 2 Feb, mostly Kyoto. Loves ceramics, wants to do a pottery course out there.
Sean got the Lisbon contract! Celebrating drinks Thursday after work. I'm buying the first round.

Long call with Yetunde tonight. Her dad's scan showed a small bleed, so they're keeping him in at least till the 10th. Her brother Isaac is flying back from Lagos on Sunday to help. She's barely eating and work keeps emailing her. I said I'd cover her Monday standup. Need to ring her Wednesday evening to see how the consultant meeting went, and remind me to drop off food at hers the week after.
Callum - client lunch moved to 27/11, 12.30 at Dishoom. His boss Hiroshi joining. Callum mentioned his wife's expecting in spring.
Mustafa says his dad's cataract surgery is on 11 December. Mustafa's taking him in. Should ask how it went the week after.
Delroy's 60th next month - 23rd of November, surprise party at the cricket club. Bethany's organising. He's after a new set of golf irons apparently.
Lwazi had an MRI on his shoulder this morning. Results in 2 weeks. Can't play five a side till then which is killing him.
Sadia's sister is having a C-section on 15/12 at 8am. Sadia's flying to Dublin for it the day before. Remind me to message her that evening for news.
Joseph and his wife Magda are both off for hip ops, his on the 3rd, hers in Jan! Joked they'll race on zimmer frames.
Didn't get much from Eamon. Back still bad, physio isn't helping, he's waiting on a referral. Sounded low. Must check in with him Friday.
Kai's sister Yasmin got into Cambridge for her masters, starts October. Kai is chuffed. Also Kai and Freya are doing up the spare room, baby due in April.
Camila mentioned her line manager Oliver is moving to the Singapore office in March. Nobody's told the team yet.
Booked my own MOT for Friday at 10. Car to garage first thing.

Hiroshi rang to say the 18 November visit is cancelled, the CEO pulled it. Rescheduling for January, probably the week of 12th. His daughter just started at university in London, so he'll come anyway on the 15th to see her.

Tobi's out of hospital as of yesterday afternoon. Yasmin said he's still very tired, walking with a frame. They've got a physio coming to the house Tuesdays and Fridays at 9. I should visit Sunday, take the kids' Lego.
Khadija's mum is having a hysterectomy on the 2nd of December. Khadija's been anxious about it, mum isn't. Ask her the day after how it went.
Zhang passed her viva with minor corrections!!! Graduation in July. Congratulate her properly when I see her Friday.
Coffee with Kavya - she's doing a pottery evening class on Tuesdays and is obsessed. Supports Arsenal. Her brother Sean is a vet in Galway.

Dawit's surgery date is set: 14 January, 7am, both him and Abdi at the Royal Free. Dawit's off work until March, his manager Laura has been really good about it. Abdi's nervous, Dawit isn't. Don't forget to text them both the evening before and visit the week after once they're allowed visitors.
Isaac's baby arrived early! Little girl, born 16 Dec at 4am. Both fine. Camila's sorting a group present.
Bethany's struggling a bit - full time job plus looking after Delroy after the knee op. Her boss isn't being flexible. She loves crime novels. Maybe get her the new Ann Cleeves as a pick-me-up.
Oliver presenting to the board on 3rd December at 2pm, first time. He was white as a sheet talking about it. Remind me to wish him luck that morning.

Grace's dad's heart bypass is pencilled in for 9/1. She's flying to Belfast on the 7th and staying a fortnight. Her husband Mustafa will hold the fort with the twins. Ask Grace the week after how he's recovering. She also said she's been offered a secondment to the Dublin team from April but won't decide until her dad's through it.
Spoke to Sinead briefly. She's doing better, back running, signed up for the Dublin half in May. New flat in Clapham from the 1st.
Need to email Magda about the Garcia account handover before she goes off on the 3rd.
Magda Garcia (Mags) said the client wants a meeting on 20 November at 11. Her colleague Eamon will join if his back allows.

Yasmin's son Abdi has his grommets op tomorrow at 7.30. She's taking the day off. Text her tomorrow afternoon. Also she said her boss, Mr Nakamura, is finally retiring on 31 March and the team is planning a big send off, she's in charge of the speech and terrified.

Anil's doing better since the funeral. Back at work, his boss gave him a lighter load. His wife Kavya's birthday is 28 Nov and he's clueless, asked me for ideas. She mentioned wanting a Le Creuset casserole dish ages ago.

Olga's son Callum is having his tonsils out on 9 December. She's going to stay with him at the hospital overnight. Remind me to send Callum some comics the week after. He's mad about Spider-Man. Olga's also mid job hunt, second interview with an NHS trust on the 2nd at 11, so wish her luck the day before.
Oliver's board presentation went brilliantly, they approved the budget.

Session with Sana went well. She's stepping down as head of sales after the merger, new role is client director from 1/2. Her cat Moon is 18 now and going downhill, vet on Monday at 4. She's sad about it.

Lunch with Lwazi and Tobi. Lwazi's shoulder results are in: torn rotator cuff, op on 13 Jan. Tobi's back at work three mornings a week, doing really well. Lwazi's worried about being off during year end. Remind me to message Lwazi the day before the op and offer to cover his month-end reports.
